audit_summary.overall_assessment: Action plan is feasible if integration milestones are controlled tightly.
key_conflicts: Aggressive KPI targets may exceed timeline if WMS latency is not reduced first.
Training standardization must be scheduled before dashboard rollout.

phase_2: Launch triage dashboard with exception categories.
Scale optimization model to all picking zones.
Run shift-level coaching based on exception analytics.

Use open interface standards to limit vendor lock-in.
